submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective detector for the completion of a familiar multi-token unit: it fires on the token that finishes a word split across tokens (sob+bed, pediatric+ian, Vacc+ine, throb+bing, reprim+and, cheer+leading) or a frozen word pair (Boy Scout, HPV testing, elder brother), driven jointly by the peak token and its specific predecessor, so the same token without its partner stays near baseline.
